title: Customer, Vendor and Item card route discovery
purpose: Inspect the New/template routes for Customers, Vendors and Items without confirming templates or saving records.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036A result exists and proves SAAR-HL with Code and Name after reopen.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Customers, Vendors and Items pages are reachable from TARGET-035 read-only evidence.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A dialog cannot be safely cancelled.
New directly creates a record before a template or mandatory-field route is understood.
A save/create/apply/OK action would be required to continue.
A customer, vendor or item record would be persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: Customers, Vendors and Items New/template routes are classified as safe/blocked without creating records.
Every opened dialog or card is screenshot-qualified and then closed/cancelled.
No customer, vendor or item is saved.
No setup, document draft, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
Result JSON includes next-step decision for the first accounting-relevant master-data write.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036A created or verified Location SAAR-HL with Code and Name only and reopen proof.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Customer, Vendor and Item records can trigger templates, posting groups and mandatory fields; their New routes need dialog discovery before any save.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Preview requires real accounting-relevant master data and accepted VAT/posting boundaries.
VAT, Page 314, inventory posting and default dimensions remain parked and may affect first documents.
Customer creation must wait for this template/dialog discovery.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It reduces the main remaining master-data risk before customer, vendor or item creation.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not confirm Apply Template or OK.
Do not save a customer, vendor or item card.
Do not infer posting readiness from a dialog screenshot.
requiredPreparation: Capture screenshot QA for each dialog/card state before closing.

screenshotQa: Cards and after-close screenshots were visually checked; classification corrected from the initial template-dialog assumption to card-with-apply-template-action.
